d: The COO is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of BloFin’s Exchange Services business, including platform operations, trading operations, client service operations, vendor coordination, operational resilience, settlement coordination, process controls, incident management, and implementation of Board- and CEO-approved policies.

The COO may also act as a Responsible Individual, if approved by VARA. VARA requires VASPs to appoint two Responsible Individuals of sufficient seniority who are responsible for the VASP’s compliance with legal and regulatory obligations. Each Responsible Individual must be a full-time employee, Fit and Proper, resident in the UAE or a UAE passport holder, and notified to and approved by VARA during licensing.

The COO reports to the CEO and provides operational reporting to the Board, Risk Committee, Compliance Committee, and other governance committees as required. If appointed as a Responsible Individual, the COO must maintain direct accountability for the Company’s regulated operational activities and compliance with applicable VARA obligations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, Engineering, Economics, or related field.
Professional certifications in operations, risk, project management, technology governance, or financial markets preferred, such as PMP, ITIL, COBIT, Six Sigma, or equivalent.
Strong understanding of exchange operations, virtual assets, client onboarding, trading venue operations, settlement coordination, custody integration, market conduct, and operational risk.
Minimum 8–10 years’ operational leadership experience in financial services, fintech, exchanges, brokerage, capital markets, banking, payments, virtual assets, or regulated technology platforms.
Experience managing trading operations, client operations, vendor coordination, incident management, and operational resilience.
Experience operating in a regulated environment and working with compliance, risk, audit, and regulators.
Experience with digital platforms, APIs, blockchain analytics, custody providers, and technology vendors preferred.
Strong operational leadership and execution discipline.
Ability to manage complex cross-functional workflows.
Strong understanding of exchange operations, settlement, reconciliation, custody coordination, and client support.
Ability to respond effectively to operational incidents and regulatory escalations.
Strong vendor management and SLA oversight capability.
Strong documentation, governance reporting, and policy implementation skills.
High integrity, accountability, and Fit and Proper suitability.
r: Oversee day-to-day operational execution of BloFin’s UAE Exchange Services business.
Ensure operational procedures are documented, implemented, tested, and followed.
Manage operational readiness for client onboarding, account activation, trading access, order execution, settlement coordination, withdrawals, support, complaints, and incident handling.
Ensure operational activities remain within BloFin’s approved Exchange Services scope.
Oversee the operational functioning of the spot trading venue.
Coordinate with the CTO and technology teams on matching engine performance, platform uptime, API availability, latency, capacity, trading system resilience, and operational incident response.
Ensure trading operations support fair, orderly, and transparent market activity.
Implement operational procedures for order handling, erroneous orders, trading interruptions, suspensions, client restrictions, and participant conduct enforcement.
Ensure Exchange Services operational controls align with VARA requirements on trading venue rules, market surveillance, trading system continuity, and settlement.
Oversee operational coordination with the appointed VARA-licensed custodian.
Ensure deposit confirmations, withdrawal-status updates, custody balance reports, reconciliation files, and transaction references are obtained and processed appropriately.
Ensure approved withdrawal instructions are transmitted to the custodian only after BloFin’s authentication, AML/CFT, sanctions, Travel Rule, wallet-risk, and operational checks are completed.
Ensure BloFin does not operate Client VA wallets, control client private keys, or execute client asset transfers directly.
Coordinate operational escalation for delayed custodian confirmations, rejected withdrawals, reconciliation breaks, and client-impacting custody issues.
Oversee client support, operational helpdesk, complaints intake, escalation workflows, and service-level performance.
Ensure Retail Clients and Qualified Investors receive appropriate operational support, platform guidance, and issue resolution.
Ensure support teams are trained on client communications, custody disclosures, withdrawal processes, escalation routes, and regulatory restrictions.
Ensure complaints and disputes are escalated to Compliance where required.

Coordinate day-to-day operational performance of key vendors and service providers, including the appointed VARA-licensed custodian, cloud hosting providers, KYC/KYB and onboarding providers, blockchain analytics providers, liquidity providers, and support providers.
Monitor operational SLAs, service interruptions, incident notifications, escalation channels, and remediation actions.
Support the Head of Risk and Compliance Officer in vendor reviews, outsourcing register updates, and operational due diligence.
Maintain operational incident response procedures and ensure incidents are escalated promptly.
Coordinate BCP/DR testing with the CTO, CISO, Risk Officer, Compliance Officer, and external service providers.
Ensure operational continuity arrangements cover trading interruptions, technology outages, custodian disruptions, vendor failures, cybersecurity events, and client support disruptions.
Support regulatory reporting and client communications during material operational incidents.

Maintain operational SOPs for onboarding handoffs, client account activation, trading operations, settlement coordination, withdrawals, support, complaints, vendor coordination, and incident response.
Ensure operational duties are segregated to reduce conflicts, errors, and abuse.
Ensure operational staff receive training and understand their regulatory responsibilities.
Implement corrective actions arising from internal audits, compliance monitoring, risk reviews, VARA feedback, and incident post-mortems.
Provide operational reports to the CEO, Board, Risk Committee, Compliance Committee, and Technology Committee.
Report KPIs and KRIs, including platform uptime, incident volumes, withdrawal processing, reconciliation exceptions, client complaints, vendor SLA performance, and operational risk events.
Support Board and Senior Management review of operational performance.

d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as a Commis Chef for the Calo Kitchen, to work along the Senior Chefs with tasks related to meal preparation, maintenance, logistics, safety and sanitation. Success in this role will be determined by your ability to support the kitchen’s efficiency and safety without compromising the quality of the meals produced for our customers.
q: Must have 1 - 3 years of experience as a commis chef or similar role within the hospitality and catering industry
Must be currently present in UAE
Must be a proficient communicator in English
Good understanding of food, health, and safety regulations
Previous experience in a food manufacturing facility experience is a plus
r: Monitors kitchen equipment and reports issues to superiors
Continually develops culinary knowledge to produce high-quality meals
Measures, mixes, and prepares meal ingredients, sauces, and seasonings
Assesses inventory and requests resupply when necessary
Plates meal items under the chef de partie’s supervision
Disposes spoiled items and adheres to sanitation regulations and safety standards
Maintain a positive and professional approach with co-workers
Produce high-quality plates both design and taste-wise

d: Sell banking products such as credit cards.
Achieve assigned monthly sales targets and business goals
Generate leads through field sales, referrals, and direct customer engagement
Explain product features, eligibility, benefits, and terms to customers
Assist customers with application submission and documentation (KYC compliance)
Ensure accurate verification of customer documents as per bank requirements
Follow up with customers on application status and approvals
Maintain strong customer relationships for repeat business and referrals.
Maintain daily sales reports, customer records, and activity updates
Coordinate with internal teams for smooth processing and onboarding
Ensure compliance with banking policies, regulations, and data confidentiality standards
Participate in sales campaigns, promotions, and outdoor marketing activities
Stay updated on banking products, offers, and competitor activities
Handle customer queries and provide timely resolutions
Work towards achieving both sales volume and quality targets
q: 1–3 years in banking sales, financial services, credit cards, or direct sales
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or related field preferred.
Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into sales
Ability to handle customer queries and objections
Fluency in English; additional languages is an advantage
